article.title: She was about to take her Ottawa business national, when the Spice Girls' lawyers threatened to sue
article.description: An Ottawa woman who has been selling her custom spice blends since she was 13 says she's being forced to change her company's name after lawyers for the pop band Spice Girls threatened to sue her.
